facts.business: Sharp Investments Limited is a non-deposit taking NBFC registered with RBI, primarily focused on providing inter-corporate loans, personal loans, loans against shares & securities, loans against properties, trading in shares & securities, and arbitrage business in stock and commodity markets.
key_risks: Competition from private banks with similar business models
Stringent RBI norms and government restrictions on NBFCs
Lack of brand recognition among large NBFC players
No branch network limiting geographic expansion
